info.announcement_bar_about: A slim bar at the very top of every page for a rotating promo or shipping message. Store-wide news, not page-specific content.
info.band_about: A flexible media + text row — image on one side, heading/copy/button on the other. Your go-to story block, feature callout or promo.
info.carousel_about: A horizontal row of items too wide for one screen — products from a collection, or manual slides. Choose slider, grid or marquee. For a full-width hero use Won Hero – carousel.
info.collection_about: A grid of products from one collection — a shop-the-range or bestsellers block for home and landing pages.
info.comparison_about: A side-by-side feature comparison — you vs the alternative — to make your advantages obvious.
info.contact_about: A contact section — a form, or a form split beside your details/map. For a contact or support page.
info.footer_about: The site footer at the bottom of every page — menus, newsletter and legal links.
info.grid_about: A tidy grid of feature cards, articles or stats. Pick the source; the cards inherit your Won styling.
info.hero_about: A single full-width hero — one headline, image and call to action. For rotating slides use Won Hero – carousel.
info.hero_carousel_about: A full-width hero that rotates through several slides (optional peek). When one hero can't carry every message.
info.hero_grid_about: A hero built from tiles side by side — one big story plus supporting cards. A bold, editorial page top.
info.marquee_about: A continuously scrolling strip of short messages or logos — trust badges, shipping perks or brand logos.
info.media_compare_about: A before/after image slider the shopper drags — show a transformation or result.
info.newsletter_about: An email sign-up block to grow your list.
info.page_header_about: The title area at the top of a page or collection — heading, breadcrumbs and intro copy.
info.panels_about: Panels shown as tabs or an accordion — FAQs, specs or content that's better folded away until needed.
info.shoppable_image_about: A lifestyle image with clickable hotspots linking to products — let shoppers buy straight from a scene.
info.tabbed_rail_about: A product rail with tabs to switch collections (e.g. Bestsellers ⇄ New in) — more ranges without more sections.
info.variant_picker_about: The product's variant selector (size, colour…) plus add-to-cart, styled to match your Won look.
info.grid_source: Blocks = a grid of Won Feature / Tile / Slide blocks you add below. Articles = cards pulled from a blog. Stats = a number row from the text field.
info.stats: One stat per line as value : label, with an optional icon/emoji as a third part: value : label : icon.
info.rows_compare: One row per line, cells separated by | . Use yes / no (or ano / ne) for ✓ / ✗, or dots:2/4 for a quality rating (2 of 4 dots filled).
info.headline_annotation: Draw a hand-sketched underline or circle on the heading, in the accent colour (flow-style).
info.mosaic: Lets a tile set to Large span 2×2 for a magazine-style layout.
info.mobile_carousel: On phones, show the items as a single swipeable row (with a peek of the next card) instead of stacking them — keeps a long list of tiles from making the page very tall.
info.columns_mobile: How many items sit side by side on phones. Hidden when the mobile carousel is on.
info.hero_layout: Single stage = one hero; Slider = a swipeable set of hero slides. Add / edit the slides as Won Slide blocks inside this section.
info.hero_min_height: Stage height. Each slide can override it with its own minimum height.
info.hero_slider_layout: Fill = one full-bleed slide at a time. Peek = a centred card with the previous / next slide peeking in on both sides (koto-style).
info.slide_width: Peek only: how wide the centred card is on desktop. Lower = more of the neighbours peek in.
info.slide_min_height: Used mainly for background slides so the stage has height. 0 = auto.
info.app_slot: This section shows a Won app block when installed; otherwise it shows the placeholder below.
info.ppu_amount: Net weight in grams (for 100 g / kg) or number of servings.
info.ppu_metafield: Optional. e.g. won.net_weight_g — overrides the reference amount when present.
info.stock_delivery: Shown when metafield won.delivery is empty.
info.ship_threshold: Order value (in your currency) for free shipping.
info.sticky_atc: Sticky bar mirrors the variant picker and appears when the buy area scrolls away.
info.sticky_style: Full spans the screen edge-to-edge. Centered pill and Corner card float above the page with rounded corners.
info.sticky_radius: Roundness of the floating Centered/Corner styles (ignored by Full).
info.sticky_offset: Gap between a floating bar and the bottom of the screen (ignored by Full).
info.nutrition_metafield: Metafield to read, as namespace.key (e.g. custom.nutrition). Works with a list of text lines, a multi-line text field, or a JSON object. The theme editor shows setup steps when it's empty.
info.label_col2_json: Leave blank to hide the second value column (also hidden for JSON metafields).
info.image_asset: Optional. Filename of a packaged theme image (in assets/) to use when no image is picked above — used for demo content. Pick your own image and it always wins.
info.image_2: Second image for the center-gutter layout — sits on the opposite side of the centred text.
info.footer_links: One per line, format: Label | url
info.footer_menu: Pick a navigation menu, or leave empty and use the manual links below.
info.tile_collection: Pick a collection to auto-use its image, title and link. A manual image/heading/link below overrides it.
info.tile_icon: Optional icon/emoji shown before the label (e.g. 💪, 🛡️) — great for shop-by-goal grids.
info.badge_text: Small corner label on the tile (e.g. New, −20%, Bestseller). Empty = no badge.
info.panels_display: Tabs = one panel at a time with a tab bar. Accordion = expandable FAQ rows. Add rows as Won Panel blocks below.
info.panel_open: Accordion mode only: this panel starts expanded.
info.split_side: Split FAQ only: what sits in the side column — the heading/contact, an image, or both.
info.split_position: Which side the image/heading column sits on: Start = left, End = right (they stack on mobile).
info.split_media: The image shown in the side column of a split FAQ. Empty shows a placeholder to replace.
info.corner_radius: Rounds the corners of cards/media in this block. 0 = square.
info.border_width: Adds an outline around the whole section. 0 = no border.
info.border_color: Color of the section outline (only when width is above 0).
info.shadow: Lifts the section off the page with a drop shadow. None = flat.
info.accent_color: Overrides this section's accent (buttons, prices, highlights) — leave empty to use the theme accent.
info.hide_mobile: Hides this whole section on phones (under 750px). It stays visible on desktop.
info.hide_desktop: Hides this whole section on desktop (750px and up). It stays visible on mobile.
info.overlay: Darkens the media with a color tint so text on top stays readable.
info.overlay_color: Color and opacity of that tint (use the alpha slider).
info.media_position: Where the image sits: above the text, beside it, or as a full background behind it.
info.background_gradient: A CSS colour or gradient behind the slide (for a photo-free gradient hero). Pair a vivid gradient with a matching colour scheme so the text stays legible.
info.card_style: Minimal = no frame. Bordered = thin outline. Elevated = surface + shadow.
info.inherit_color_scheme: On = use the section’s colors. Off = pick a different scheme for this block.
info.section_width: Page = aligned to the content width. Full = edge-to-edge (best for background media).
info.color_scheme: One of the theme color schemes (Settings → Colors).
info.token_kind: A text token or an image token (e.g. a small logo).
info.marquee_link: Optional: turn this text token into a link.
info.marquee_duration: How long one full loop takes. Lower = faster.
info.pause_on_hover: Stop the scroll while the pointer is over the strip.
info.tabrail_title: Tab label. Empty = the collection's name.
info.hotspot_pos: Position of the pin on the image, as a percentage from the top-left.
info.hotspot_mobile_pos: On: this pin uses its own position on phones (the mobile fields below); off: it keeps the desktop position everywhere.
info.hotspot_label: Optional label shown instead of the product's title.
info.columns: How many items sit side by side on desktop.
info.hero_grid_columns: How many tiles side by side on desktop. Add or remove tiles freely below — tablet shows 2, mobile 1.
info.ann_display: Rotate cycles messages one at a time; Single shows only the first block.
info.ann_interval: How long each message stays visible (rotate only).
info.ann_dismissible: Adds a close button; the bar stays hidden for the rest of the visit.
info.ann_link: Optional: make the whole message a link (e.g. to a new collection).
info.show_side_media: Adds an image beside the heading and contact in the side column. The heading and the FAQ questions always stay — this never hides them.
